focus: Twelve zodiac seals and selected special gestures
Selected anime, movie and later-era variants, labelled individually
limitations: This is a bounded research catalogue, not every hand sign or technique across the franchise.
Exact sequences are secondary-reported; original manga panels and anime footage have not been audited.
Source medium is unspecified when the accessed infobox combines media without identifying a scene.
Primary articles corroborate abilities and associations only unless a variant explicitly states otherwise.
Sign geometry, one-handed variants and model training remain separate work.
Effect suggestions are app design proposals, not canonical activation requirements.

notes: Ordered steps are symbolic IDs, not a trained classifier or landmark thresholds.
steps null means unresolved; an empty array is allowed only for an explicit no-seals report. Neither is a castable empty pattern.
Repeated steps and special variants must not be collapsed; shared and prefix sequences need explicit disambiguation.
Names and aliases do not establish mirroring equivalence, a particular hand count, or exact finger geometry.

signs.name: Akimichi Seal
signs.description: Raise index and little fingers; fold and interlock middle/ring fingers against the opposite hand and join thumbs. Provisional secondary description; anime drawings vary.

signs.name: Clap Hands
signs.description: Palms-together action or held posture, as specified by the technique. Do not require a clap motion for every occurrence.

signs.name: Clone Seal
signs.description: Cross the paired index and middle fingers of both hands. Exact pose reference still required.

signs.name: Crossed Tiger
signs.description: A Tiger-like pose with middle fingers crossed over the index fingers, according to the reference. Exact original-panel geometry remains to be checked.

signs.name: Finger Gun
signs.description: Aim the index finger in a finger-gun pose. Gesture geometry is provisional; the source describes this action as directing Water Gun.

signs.description: Unnamed intermediate seal; exact geometry unresolved.

signs.description: Technique-specific symbolic class; exact finger geometry requires image references before training. Kept separate from the Mind Body Switch seal.

signs.description: Technique-specific symbolic class; exact finger geometry and performer variants require image references before training. The source explicitly names a special seal but this dataset does not yet specify its shape.

signs.name: Modified Ox for Mystical Palm
signs.description: Modified Ox referenced for Mystical Palm; exact modification unresolved.

signs.name: Seal of Confrontation
signs.description: One-handed half-seal used for engagement and chakra focus. Pose reference required.

signs.name: Seal of Reconciliation
signs.description: Post-sparring paired gesture; not a jutsu trigger. Pose reference required.

signs.name: Shikamaru Bird Variant
signs.description: Raise ring and little fingers; interlock index and middle fingers, with thumbs facing the performer. Distinct from basic Bird. No additional ordered sequence is inferred here.

signs.name: Slam surface
signs.description: Place the hand or hands against the affected surface. Sandwich specifically lists both hands on the ground; this is an action, not a zodiac seal.

signs.name: Tearing Earth Turning Palm seal
signs.description: Reference describes a downward-facing cupped left hand beside a right hand with index and middle fingers raised. Geometry remains secondary-reported.

signs.name: Water Prison palms-out gesture
signs.description: Hands extended forward, palms facing outward, with thumbs and index fingers meeting, as described by the reference. Original pose image not inspected.

signs.name: Water Formation Wall anime cupping seal
signs.description: Reference describes the right hand cupping the left hand with a thumbs-up. The complete anime sequence around it remains unresolved.

signs.name: Yang Water (Jin)
signs.description: Non-zodiac seal also called Jin. It is distinct from similarly named movie invocations; visual reference required.
